Lab 1.title: Lab 1 — HTML Basics
Lab 1.description: Document structure, headings, emphasis, lists, images and relative links between pages.

Lab 2.title: Lab 2 — Tables, Forms & Semantic HTML
Lab 2.description: Semantic page structure, data tables with spanning cells, and interactive form controls.

Lab 3.title: Lab 3 — Elements, Layout & Forms
Lab 3.description: Block vs inline elements, `div` page layout, HTML entities, the HTML5 input types and the `output` element, plus a working contact page.

Lab 4.title: Lab 4 — CSS, Video & Navigation
Lab 4.description: Chapter 4 practice pages — semantic structure, an embedded `<video>`, a CSS navigation bar, the selector types and text-decoration — followed by the two handout problems: the Visit Terengganu tourism page and the e-Café Campus debug-and-extend.

Lab 5.title: Lab 5 — CSS Part 2
Lab 5.description: The CSS Part 2 chapter worked through in order — inline, internal and external styles, a style sheet borrowed from Google Fonts, background images, a styled data table and a navigation bar — then Lab Exercise 5's UMT profile page (`umt.html` + `umt.css`), followed by the two handout problems: the Taste of Terengganu festival page and the Campus Bookstore debug-and-extend.

Lab 6.title: Lab 6 — JavaScript
Lab 6.description: The JavaScript chapter in order — `document.write` and `getElementById()`, the date and time, changing an image's `src`, an external `.js` file, an event listener, a generated multiplication table, two kinds of client-side validation and a guessing game — then Lab Exercise 6's timed quiz, followed by the two problems in the additional handout: the Rock, Paper, Scissors game and the grade calculator that had to be debugged and extended.

gallery.title: Validation Evidence
gallery.description: W3C markup and CSS validation results for the exercise pages, followed by a run-through of the Lab 6 Rock, Paper, Scissors game.

Lab 1/lab1.html.title: About Me
Lab 1/lab1.html.description: Personal introduction with hobbies, favourite movies and an image element.

Lab 1/lab1_ExerA.html.title: Kopi Pantai Café
Lab 1/lab1_ExerA.html.description: Seaside café page using headings, `strong`, `em` and a description list.

Lab 1/lab1_ExerB.html.title: Campus Coding Club
Lab 1/lab1_ExerB.html.description: Thirteen markup errors identified and corrected, plus a two-page navigation bar.

Lab 1/contact.html.title: Contact Us
Lab 1/contact.html.description: Second page of the club site with committee members and contact details.

Lab 3/block.html.title: Block and Inline Elements
Lab 3/block.html.description: How block elements claim a whole line while inline elements stay inside the flow of the text.

Lab 3/div.html.title: Page Layout with div
Lab 3/div.html.description: Header, columns and footer built from `div` containers with inline background, width and float styles.

Lab 3/entity.html.title: HTML Entities
Lab 3/entity.html.description: Writing reserved characters — `<`, `>`, `©`, non-breaking space — by name and by number.

Lab 3/input5.html.title: HTML5 Input Types
Lab 3/input5.html.description: A tour of `color`, `date`, `range`, `email` and friends so the browser shows the right picker.

Lab 3/lab3.html.title: Contact Us — TechWeb Solutions
Lab 3/lab3.html.description: Div-based layout with an HTML5 contact form (`email`, `date`, `range`) and a live `output` sum calculator.

Lab 3/output5.html.title: The output Element
Lab 3/output5.html.description: A live addition machine that recalculates into `output` on every keystroke or slider move.

Lab 2/lab2.html.title: Personal Profile
Lab 2/lab2.html.description: Semantic layout combining a personal information table and a contact form.

Lab 2/Lab2_ExerA.html.title: FSKM Tech Day 2026
Lab 2/Lab2_ExerA.html.description: Event page with `header`, `nav`, `section` and `article` plus in-page anchors.

Lab 2/Lab2_ExerB.html.title: Course Feedback
Lab 2/Lab2_ExerB.html.description: Ten markup and accessibility errors fixed in a table-and-form feedback page.

Lab 2/semantic.html.title: Semantic HTML Example
Lab 2/semantic.html.description: Reference example of semantic elements replacing generic containers.

Lab 2/table.html.title: Working with Tables
Lab 2/table.html.description: Basic tables plus `colspan` for merged header and summary cells.

Lab 2/form.html.title: Creating Forms
Lab 2/form.html.description: Text inputs, radio buttons, checkboxes, select menu and submit button.

Lab 3/lab3_ExerA.html.title: CampusBake® — Online Order
Lab 3/lab3_ExerA.html.description: Five `div` sections, a HTML5 order form (`tel`, `email`, `date`, `time`, `color`, `range`, `datalist`) and a live `output` price total.

Lab 3/lab3_ExerB.html.title: Ticket Booking — Debug & Extend
Lab 3/lab3_ExerB.html.description: Thirteen deliberate errors found and fixed, then extended with a Now Showing sidebar, `tel`/`time` inputs and a second `output`.

Lab 3/inattribute5.html.title: HTML5 Input Attributes
Lab 3/inattribute5.html.description: `placeholder`, `autofocus`, `required` and `autocomplete` at work on a club sign-up form.

Lab 3/intro5_broken.html.title: Intro Page — broken version
Lab 3/intro5_broken.html.description: Deliberately invalid `<!DOCTYPE>` used to practise the validator; the errors it triggers are listed at the end of the file.

Lab 3/intro5.html.title: Introduction to HTML5
Lab 3/intro5.html.description: The corrected intro page — proper `<!DOCTYPE html>`, `lang`, UTF-8 charset — validating with no errors or warnings.

Lab 4/lab4_ExerA.html.title: Visit Terengganu — Tourism Page
Lab 4/lab4_ExerA.html.description: `header`/`nav`/three `section`s/`footer`, three destination `article`s with crossed-out prices, a seat `meter`, a captioned `<video>`, a `.trip-form` and all four link states — styled from `style.css` plus two page-only rules.

Lab 4/lab4_ExerB.html.title: e-Café Campus — Debug & Extend
Lab 4/lab4_ExerB.html.description: Fourteen faults in the given code found and listed by line number, then corrected and extended: `cafe.css`, a styled nav bar, `.old-price` line-through, a captioned video and a `.feedback-form`.

Lab 4/Class.html.title: Class Selector
Lab 4/Class.html.description: A `.center` class shared by a heading and a paragraph, with a third paragraph left-aligned because it has no class at all.

Lab 4/navigation.html.title: CSS Navigation Bar
Lab 4/navigation.html.description: A bullet list turned into a vertical menu bar: bullets removed, each link shown as a block with a background colour, and a darker colour on `:hover` and `:active`.

Lab 4/stail.html.title: My First CSS
Lab 4/stail.html.description: Internal CSS at its simplest — one type selector turns every paragraph blue and centres it, so a single rule styles the whole page.

Lab 4/stailID.html.title: ID Selector
Lab 4/stailID.html.description: An `#intro` rule that styles only the paragraph carrying that id, while the unclassed paragraph beside it keeps the default look.

Lab 4/stailLink.html.title: Styling Link States
Lab 4/stailLink.html.description: `:link`, `:visited`, `:hover` and `:active` written in the correct order, each with its own red, green, magenta or blue colour.

Lab 4/structure.html.title: Semantic Page Structure
Lab 4/structure.html.description: A `header`, three `section`s, a `meter` gauge and a `footer` holding `©` plus an `address` with a `mailto:` link — the skeleton Problem A builds on.

Lab 4/Teks.html.title: Text Decoration
Lab 4/Teks.html.description: `overline`, `line-through`, `underline` and a combined `underline overline` value, one per heading level.

Lab 4/video.html.title: Video in HTML5
Lab 4/video.html.description: A `<video>` element with `width`, `height` and `controls`, a `<source type="video/mp4">` and fallback text for browsers without video support.

Lab 5/food.html.title: Taste of Terengganu — Food Festival
Lab 5/food.html.description: A photographic header with `background-size: cover`, a floated CSS menu with hover and an `.active` item, Google Fonts, an inline-styled notice, an internal `h2` rule and an eight-row stalls table with alternating and hover rows.

Lab 5/shop.html.title: Campus Bookstore — Debug & Extend
Lab 5/shop.html.description: Sixteen faults in the supplied HTML and CSS found and listed with file and line number, then corrected and extended: `header`/`nav`/`main`/`footer`, two Google Fonts, an active menu item and a table with single borders, zebra rows and right-aligned prices.

Lab 5/inline.html.title: Inline CSS
Lab 5/inline.html.description: The same page styled straight onto the elements with the `style` attribute — a blue 24px heading and a paragraph on a yellow, padded background.

Lab 5/internal.html.title: Internal CSS
Lab 5/internal.html.description: The rules moved into a `<style>` block in `<head>`: a green centred heading and a pale paragraph panel.

Lab 5/external.html.title: External CSS
Lab 5/external.html.description: The styles kept in `style.css` beside the page and pulled in with a `<link>`, so one sheet can dress a whole site.

Lab 5/link.html.title: CSS from Another Website
Lab 5/link.html.description: Roboto loaded from Google's font service and applied with a `font-family` rule — no font files in the repository at all.

Lab 5/bgImage.html.title: Background Images
Lab 5/bgImage.html.description: Two background images on one element: a tiled photograph and a second placed once in the corner, using `background-position` and a two-value `background-repeat`.

Lab 5/table.html.title: CSS Table
Lab 5/table.html.description: The `#customers` sheet — single collapsed borders, zebra rows, a hover highlight and an uppercase white-on-teal header.

Lab 5/navigation.html.title: CSS Navigation Bar
Lab 5/navigation.html.description: An unordered list turned into a horizontal bar: bullets and default margins stripped, items floated, links turned into blocks and darkened on hover.

Lab 5/umt.html.title: Universiti Malaysia Terengganu
Lab 5/umt.html.description: Lab Exercise 5: a full page about UMT with `header`, `nav`, `section`, `article` and `footer`, an external `umt.css`, two Google Fonts, a gradient background, a milestone table with alternating and hover rows, and a centred footer.

Lab 6/firstjs.html.title: My First JS
Lab 6/firstjs.html.description: `document.write()` printing bold and italic text, then a button that rewrites a paragraph through `getElementById()` and `innerHTML`.

Lab 6/datetimejs.html.title: Date and Time
Lab 6/datetimejs.html.description: A button that writes `Date()` into a paragraph with `innerText`, then recolours the same element through its `style` object.

Lab 6/changelight.html.title: Changing an Attribute
Lab 6/changelight.html.description: Two buttons swap the `src` of one image, so the bulb lights up and goes dark without a reload — `getElementById(...).src` in its simplest form.

Lab 6/extjavascript.html.title: External JavaScript
Lab 6/extjavascript.html.description: `message.js` linked from `<head>` and called by `onclick`, keeping the function out of the page and reusable.

Lab 6/disable-right-click.html.title: Working with Events
Lab 6/disable-right-click.html.description: A `contextmenu` listener with `preventDefault()` — the browser's own right-click menu is replaced by an alert.

Lab 6/multiplication-table.html.title: Multiplication Table
Lab 6/multiplication-table.html.description: Two number inputs and a loop that builds a rows × columns table as a string, then drops it into the page with `innerHTML`.

Lab 6/form-validation.html.title: Form Validation
Lab 6/form-validation.html.description: Submitting with an empty field is blocked by returning `false` from the `onsubmit` handler; filling it in reports success.

Lab 6/numeric-validation.html.title: Numeric Validation
Lab 6/numeric-validation.html.description: Four cases in one script: empty, `isNaN()`, an age outside 1–120, and a value that passes every check.

Lab 6/guess-number.html.title: Guess a Number
Lab 6/guess-number.html.description: `Math.random()` and `Math.floor()` pick a secret number from 1 to 10, `prompt()` takes the guess and the result comes back through `alert()`.

Lab 6/index.html.title: Quiz Application
Lab 6/index.html.description: Lab Exercise 6: a timed multiple-choice quiz with shuffled questions, per-question countdown, instant feedback and a live score, split across `index.html`, `quiz.css` and `script.js`.

Lab 6/lab6_ExerA.html.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
Lab 6/lab6_ExerA.html.description: The club open-day game: a name and a Start Game button, three weapon buttons, two pictures that change every round, a coloured result, a live scoreboard, a round-by-round history table and a summary that counts wins with a `for` loop. Split across `lab6_ExerA.html`, `style.css` and `game.js`.

Lab 6/grade.html.title: Student Grade Calculator — Debug & Extend
Lab 6/grade.html.description: Thirteen errors in the supplied `grade.html` and `grade.js` listed with file and line number, then fixed and extended: empty-mark check, colour by grade, a Random Mark button, the date and time of the check, and a `grade.css` sheet.
